newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman cuts Bristol Hotel.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman cuts Bristol Hotel.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers said it downgraded Bristol Hotel Co to outperform from buy due to the stock's price.

-- Analyst Joyce Minor said in a summary report that Bristol's shares have gained 52 percent since it confirmed in December that it was in talks to acquire a portfolio of Holiday Inn hotels from Bass Plc.
-- "We continue to view this transaction favorably and expect significant earnings growth at Bristol from improvements of the portfolio, most significantly in 1999 and beyond," the report said.
